what: Along the mouse path, 4px short pencil marks are stamped every 11px, lying in the direction of movement (6 · 14px below and to the right of the cursor tip), and each mark fades over .9s with opacity .7·remaining time². The underlay is inverted (difference) so it shows on any background

options.ox / oy: Offset from the cursor tip (px), default 6 · 14

from.where: shared.js pencilTrail(.fx-trail) — original flat.js pencil cursor trail (lifetime 900ms · 11px spacing · 4px · (6, 14) offset · 1.6px line · density .7v² · difference)

note: Draws with the mouse only. The original lays white marks over the underlay with difference to invert it — the default --kf-contrast-ink is dark on dark skins so the inversion weakens, to always invert like the original, give --fx-trail a bright color
